title: Bump MSRV from 1.80 to 1.95
description:
User directive 2026-04-27 ('Lets bump up our msrv too' / 'no need to use anything ancient'). Discovered during bd00d76a session work after restoring rustup shims (stub layer in ~/.cargo/bin/ was masking real cargo since 2025-11-09).

## Background

MSRV has been pinned at 1.80 since project init. Newly-installed stable is 1.95.0 (rustc 1.95.0 (59807616e 2026-04-14)). User wants the floor raised to remove the previous 'restrict to stable intrinsics on MSRV' option in CLAUDE.md's Breakdown-time feasibility check; e.g., AVX-512 _mm512_* clmul/extract intrinsics stabilised in 1.89 are now usable.

## Files to update

- crates/gf2-core/Cargo.toml: rust-version = '1.80' → '1.95'
- crates/gf2-coding/Cargo.toml: rust-version = '1.80' → '1.95'
- crates/gf2-kernels-hip/Cargo.toml: rust-version = '1.80' → '1.95'
- dev/research/rns_prototype/Cargo.toml: rust-version = '1.80' → '1.95'
- CLAUDE.md MSRV section (line 177-179): 'Rust 1.80' → 'Rust 1.95'
- CLAUDE.md Breakdown-time feasibility check (line 196-204): '1.80.0' → '1.95.0' in the rustup run example; AVX-512 intrinsic example becomes a historical note rather than current constraint.
- gf2-kernels-simd has no rust-version pin, no change needed there.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] cargo check --workspace --all-features passes on stable (1.95).
- [hard] cargo nextest run --workspace --all-features --release --profile ci passes (fast tier).
- [hard] cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings clean.
- [hard] CLAUDE.md MSRV section reflects new floor; Breakdown-time feasibility check example updated.
- [hard] CI workflows (.github/workflows/*.yml) still use dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable (or master) so they automatically track new MSRV.

## Notes

This is a project-level housekeeping change, not part of any current epic. Adjacent to bd00d76a (asm audit) only by virtue of session timing.
